{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Reluctant''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that took part in the [[Battle of ThonBoka]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>. It was one of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] that was deceived into firing upon one of its sister ships due to the [[Artificial skin|strategy]] of the [[Oswaft]].
